context: Bitquery's RLUSD investigation identifies a 110-wallet dust cluster funded from Binance-labelled wallets, including rDAE53. The same exact rDAE53 address is one of five Binance-labelled XRPL sources in the 233.46M XRP incident and later sent XRP and RLUSD to another Binance-labelled account. The investigation also decomposes $7.33B of gross RLUSD movement into issuer plumbing, a matched roundtrip and concentrated high-value transfers.
decisions: Separate stablecoin payment count, gross transfer value, unique senders/receivers, issuer mint/redemption, matched roundtrips, exchange/custody omnibus flows, known bot clusters and net external settlement into distinct metrics.
Do not use raw RLUSD payment count as organic adoption, XRP demand or a price-prediction feature when a bot cluster accounts for 99.6% of the sample count.
Treat the $7.33B as gross ledger movement; isolate $1.472B issuer mint/redemption and the $848M matched roundtrip before attempting net-capital estimates.
A matching XRPL address across separate investigations creates an exact-address relationship edge only. It does not establish common beneficial ownership, common operator, intent or causation.

Classify post-incident rDAE53-to-rs8Z payments as confirmed ledger transfers between explorer-labelled Binance accounts; do not call them replenishment, recovery or reserve restoration without official evidence.
Do not treat Bithomp page balances as exact when title and body fields conflict. Require raw validated account_info or an independently reconciled explorer snapshot before admitting balance features.
Treat Cross River announcement and bot shutdown as a timestamped temporal association only; retain coincidence and off-chain operational change as competing explanations.
Keep all RLUSD activity out of the XRP price feature store until historical, point-in-time, cross-venue data and a defensible XRP transmission mechanism are established.
Add an actual-repository validator invocation to the XRP ledger GitHub Actions workflow; isolated fixture tests alone do not prove the checked-out research index and archive pointers are valid.
invariants: Native XRP, RLUSD, USDC, USDT and other issued assets remain distinct; stablecoin payment activity is not automatically XRP demand.
Gross transfer volume is never labelled net capital or settlement without beneficial-owner and flow classification.
Issuer mint/redemption and matched roundtrip flows are separated from external counterparties.
Provider labels are not official exchange PoR exports and do not prove beneficial ownership.
An exact address match is not an actor attribution.
Dynamic account-page balance displays with internal discrepancies are not admitted as exact account balances.
No prediction is issued until immutable fixed-horizon outcomes, point-in-time features, baseline comparisons, calibration and walk-forward validation are executed and verified.
